kicker: 3 WAYS TO BE HARD TO INTIMIDATE
title: Intimidation only works if you *adjust* for it

label: WAY 1
head: Ask: "What do you mean by that?"
sub: Loaded comment? Don't laugh it off. If it was innocent, fine. If not, now he has to own it.

head: Someone catches you off guard
r: Looks at him, waits 3 seconds, then answers

label: WAY 2
head: Let them wait for your answer
sub: Silence feels long to you. To everyone else it looks like control.

label: WAY 3
head: Stop auditioning for cold people
sub: Some people give zero warmth and watch you work harder. Stop performing.

text: Nobody can make you *feel small* unless you shrink first.

head: Stay *the same guy* in every room
